title: malus sylvestris var. lemoinei
intro: Malus sylvestris var. lemoinei, commonly known as the wild apple, is a variety of wild apple tree that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Malus sylvestris var. lemoinei include its antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it effective in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Malus sylvestris var. lemoinei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
